secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs listener and admin login sessions. Any long random string; Base44 stores it encrypted and it never reaches the repo.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client ID (type: Web application). Paste the client ID and add the app's origin under 'Authorized JavaScript origins'. Switches on the 'Sign in with Google' button; the API verifies the token with the same id.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys → Secret key (sk_test_… while testing). Switches on card checkout for Premium memberships and paid downloads.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → add endpoint <api origin>/api/payments/webhook for checkout.session.completed, then copy its signing secret (whsec_…). Optional: the back-from-checkout confirmation already grants access, this is the authoritative path for a real deployment.

secrets.name: PRCPAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: PrcPay merchant API key from your PrcPay dashboard; sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Switches on PrcPay — instant pay-ins by PrcPay card and instant payouts to owners' PrcPay accounts.

secrets.name: PRCPAY_BASE_URL
secrets.description: The PrcPay API host the server should call, e.g. https://api.prcpay.com or the public URL of your own PrcPay server — it must be reachable from the app's server, not just from your browser. Left unset, the sandbox uses the local stand-in at http://prcpay:3001/api (docker-compose.base44.yml + prcpay-dev/). Endpoint paths are configurable too: PRCPAY_CHARGE_PATH and PRCPAY_TRANSFER_PATH (defaults /charge and /transfer), e.g. /api/charge behind a base that ends in /api.

secrets.name: PRCPAY_ACCOUNT
secrets.description: This platform's own PrcPay account, sent to PrcPay as 'merchant'. Defaults to streamcastpro — set it if your PrcPay merchant account is named differently.

secrets.name: PRCPAY_WEBHOOK_IPS
secrets.description: Comma-separated source addresses PrcPay's settlement notifications come from. Notifications carry no signature, so this allowlist is the whole check — without it POST /api/prcpay/webhook refuses every caller (403).
